leaderboards.task: Image and motion prompt to silent video: short Chinese internet memes
notes: Public browser leaderboard for image-plus-prompt MemeBench. Clips are delivered silent; the content emphasizes short Chinese internet meme scenarios. This is a separate specialized scoring pool.
Scores fit eligible pre-reveal preference votes using ridge-regularized Bradley-Terry with a prior centered at 1200 Elo. Tie and Both bad each contribute 0.5. Price never affects the quality score.

Source 95% intervals are approximate and are not evaluator-clustered. Anonymous sessions may contribute multiple evaluations. Coverage is sparse and serving weights are not inverse-propensity reweighted.

No dated score publication or precise dataset revision is shown on the leaderboard. sourceUpdatedAt is null. The methodology update (2026-08-17) and pricing check (2026-09-01) are different events and are not used as score publication dates.

Prices are published by this same source in USD per output second and need no minute-to-second conversion. They use 720p with explicit model exceptions, optional audio off, and exclude fixed input fees. This pricing configuration differs from Artificial Analysis.

The pricing tooltip states that inseparable native audio can remain included in API costs, while benchmark playback is silent. Grok input-image fees and Ray duration non-linearity are preserved in priceNote.
Exact source display names and configuration IDs are retained together. Provider labels remain source literals, including fal. No cross-source prices or model URLs are joined.
